artifacts.title: Ordination ban for men self-identifying as gay Christians

matches.evidence: The CCB found this overture to amend BCO 17 prohibiting ordination of men using gay-identity labels to be in conflict with existing BCO provisions, though it was adopted.

artifacts.title: Prohibiting ordination of men who self-identify as gay or homosexual Christians
artifacts.disposition: withdrawn by submitting presbytery; no advice rendered

matches.evidence: An overture to amend BCO 17 barring ordination of self-identified gay or homosexual Christians was withdrawn by Lowcountry Presbytery; no CCB advice was rendered.
